topic: Get found locally: 4 things on your Google Business Profile

image_defaults.prompt_suffix: Visual style: calm, precise, premium, quiet confidence. A matte warm paper ground (#F7F5F0) with fine paper-fibre grain, one soft natural light source and a soft shadow, no gloss. Palette: warm paper, ink (#0C2027), slate, and at most ONE small gold (#F5C13A) accent, with at most a touch of muted teal. Large areas of deliberate empty negative space so text can be placed on top later. Flat, restrained, editorial. Avoid: neon, lens flare, glossy 3D blobs, cyber grids, circuit boards, rockets, light bulbs, handshakes, stock-photo people, faces, hands, fake UI, charts, and any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks in the image.

assets.prompt: A folded blank paper map with soft grey line shapes only and no labels, and a single small brass map pin lying on it, on a warm paper surface with a soft shadow. Everything sits in the lower half of the frame; the upper 45% is empty ground. Shot straight from above. No printed or written text anywhere.

slides.title: Pick the right category.
slides.lead: It tells Google what you are. Choose the one closest to your main service.

slides.title: Keep hours accurate.
slides.lead: Wrong hours send customers away. Update them for holidays too.

slides.title: Add real photos.
slides.lead: Your shopfront, your work, your team. Not stock.

slides.title: Reply to reviews.
slides.lead: Short, polite, human. Every reply shows you are open for business.

caption:
Get found near you.

Four things to check on your Google Business Profile: the right category, accurate hours, real photos and replies to reviews.

Message us to begin.
